located_observations.location: upper-left entry and full right crop
located_observations.observation: The red date and the cropped repair hands are the strongest anchors. A single left axis continues through title and body to the practical list; no two footer groups.
Three continuous serif lines read from a stable left start, with open Korean counters and distinct spaces. Their right edge approaches the chair upright without glyph overlap.
One hand grips the upright while another holds an exposed rail tenon near it. The joint is visibly separated during repair, not yet inserted; contact at the final socket is not demonstrated.

A shirt with collar and button rests on the same chair seat. One hand flattens the red stitched patch while a second holds the needle and thread. Needle meets the patch edge; sleeve/wrist/hand boundaries remain legible.
Petrol wood cuts and red sleeves/patch carry bounded carved grain. Type remains clean and precisely aligned over continuous ivory paper.
Event, place, fee, deadline, invitation and URL stay adjacent and readable on one continuous left start.

style.checked_requirement: Date-led left continuous information spine with a full-height diagonal two-ink linocut chair/garment repair action
style.observation: Implemented in petrol/red on warm ivory. Actual image organizes the shared edge; its major repair shapes fill the right half and reach the spine boundary. No passive gothic template, empty room, central title island or twin footer.

ratio.observation: 941px height is nearest-integer rounding of 940.5; within predeclared <=0.5px tolerance. Native bytes were not resized.

substantive_visual.observation: Two people physically brace and align chair parts; two additional hands sew a visible patch on the shirt draped across that same chair.

hangul.observation: Native title and paragraph show consistent serif syllable widths and open mature counters; word boundaries are stable. Sturdy sans practical information remains separated from print grain.

information_relationship.observation: Date/time lead down a single title/proposition/paragraph axis, then to one event/place/participation spine. No remote required information.

function_contact.observation: Grips support the separated rail/upright; patch-holding and needle action are visible. A completed chair joint connection is not shown; this is an in-progress gesture.

local_finish.observation: Angular negative cuts, repeated wood-grain direction and clean text boundaries read consistently; the fine grain and stitch detail reduces at thumbnail size.

extra_print.observation: Only the supplied entries are visible once; no logo, watermark, QR or invented print observed.

residuals.limit: Required en-dash glyph class remains unresolved after the single exact-asset revisit; bounded punctuation repair is warranted.
Repair is shown with the rail tenon still separated; the image does not demonstrate the completed insertion.
320px is useful for route and image recognition; small body and fine sewing detail require the 720/native views.

repair_decision.cause: Actual punctuation-shape uncertainty in required time string, not plan geometry mismatch.
maintain: two-ink print and legible hand ownership
